summary: Menominee County, WI tower on the Menominee Indian Reservation, listed as standing. No build, design or staffing history found; visiting needs tribal permission.

notes_for_editor: Thin sources: one undated inventory list (FFLA) and one Forest Lookouts page. Build year, design, height, operator and current condition are all unknown. The record's agency field holds 'Menominee Indian Reservation', which is a place, not an operator; confirm with the tribe before using it. Two WebSearch queries and one Wisconsin Historical Society fetch returned nothing about this tower (the HI22302 record is Bass Lake, Florence County, not this tower). The OpenStreetMap node 353894126 tags it ele=327 m; not used in the story. Not checked on the ground.
